name: Polygon3D
shortDescription: Procedural 3D polygon objects with native per-face textures, slicing, and optional internal faces.
description: Custom procedural 3D Object Extension suite for GDevelop. Includes HexBipyramid3D and RhombicDodecahedron3D with per-face textures and visibility, fixed upper/lower face groups, horizontal center faces, internal radial geometry, and Three.js BufferGeometry material grouping.
author: Twillion

eventsBasedObjects.name: HexBipyramid3D
eventsBasedObjects.description: A 14-face beveled diamond block with canonical isometric orientation, uniform proportions, native texture uploading, dynamic half-block slicing, and collision support.

eventsFunctions.name: SetBlockState
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set block slicing state of _PARAM0_ to _PARAM1_
eventsFunctions.description: Change the slicing display state to Full, Bottom Half, or Top Half. Automatically updates materials, 3D bounds, and colliders.

eventsFunctions.name: SetFaceVisibility
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set visibility of face _PARAM1_ on _PARAM0_ to _PARAM2_
eventsFunctions.description: Show or hide any individual face of the 14-face bipyramid or the internal cut face.

eventsFunctions.name: SetFaceTexture
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set texture of face _PARAM1_ on _PARAM0_ to _PARAM2_
eventsFunctions.description: Set or change the image texture resource for any individual face (or leave empty to reset to default GDevelop texture).

eventsFunctions.name: SetRepeatTextureOnFace
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set repeat texture on face _PARAM1_ of _PARAM0_ to _PARAM2_
eventsFunctions.description: Enable or disable texture tiling and repetition across a specific face.

eventsFunctions.name: SetEquatorRadius
eventsFunctions.description: Change the middle hexagonal equator radius (Req) and rebuild procedural geometry.

eventsFunctions.name: SetCapRadius
eventsFunctions.description: Change the top and bottom flat hexagonal cap radius (Rcap) and rebuild procedural geometry.

eventsFunctions.name: SetTotalHeight
eventsFunctions.description: Change the full block height (H) and rebuild procedural geometry.

eventsFunctions.name: SetTint
eventsFunctions.description: Change the color tint of the polygon material.

eventsFunctions.name: SetTileScale
eventsFunctions.description: Change the tile scale factor for repeating textures.

eventsFunctions.name: SnapToHexGrid
eventsFunctions.fullName: Snap object to honeycomb hex grid
eventsFunctions.sentence: Snap _PARAM0_ to honeycomb grid with equator radius _PARAM1_
eventsFunctions.description: Snaps the object (X, Z) position to the nearest gapless hexagonal honeycomb grid center.

eventsFunctions.name: IsBlockState
eventsFunctions.description: Check if the bipyramid is in the specified slicing state (Full, Bottom Half, or Top Half).

eventsFunctions.name: IsFaceVisible
eventsFunctions.description: Check if a specific face of the bipyramid is currently visible.

eventsFunctions.name: ShouldRepeatTextureOnFace
eventsFunctions.description: Check if a specific face has texture repeating enabled.

eventsFunctions.name: IsFull
eventsFunctions.description: Check if the diamond block is in the Full state.

eventsFunctions.name: IsHalfBlock
eventsFunctions.description: Check if the block is currently sliced into a half-block (Bottom Half or Top Half).

eventsFunctions.name: BlockState
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the current block slicing state ("Full", "Bottom Half", or "Top Half").

eventsFunctions.name: FaceTexture
eventsFunctions.sentence: Get texture resource of face _PARAM1_ on _PARAM0_
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the texture resource name assigned to a specific face.

eventsFunctions.name: TileScale
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the texture tile scale factor.

eventsFunctions.name: SurfaceY
eventsFunctions.description: Deprecated: use SurfaceZ. The block is Z-up, so this elevation is along Z despite the name. Returns the top walkable surface elevation in world coordinates (0 for Bottom Half).

eventsFunctions.name: EquatorRadius
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the middle hexagonal equator radius (Req).

eventsFunctions.name: CapRadius
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the top and bottom cap radius (Rcap).

eventsFunctions.name: TotalHeight
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the total height (H) of the full bipyramid block.

eventsFunctions.name: EffectiveHeight
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the active collision height of the block (H for Full, H/2 for half blocks).

eventsFunctions.name: CenterOffsetY
eventsFunctions.description: Deprecated: use CenterOffsetZ. The block is Z-up, so this offset runs along Z despite the name. Returns 0 for Full, -H/4 for Bottom Half, +H/4 for Top Half.

eventsFunctions.name: SurfaceZ
eventsFunctions.sentence: Get top surface Z elevation of _PARAM0_
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the top walkable surface Z elevation in world coordinates (0 for Bottom Half).

eventsFunctions.name: CenterOffsetZ
eventsFunctions.sentence: Get vertical center offset Z of _PARAM0_
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the vertical center offset along Z (0 for Full, -H/4 for Bottom Half, +H/4 for Top Half).

eventsFunctions.name: SetDirectedHalf
eventsFunctions.description: Retain one of six symmetrical radial halves by shell-fragment visibility and expose its complete center cut face.

eventsFunctions.name: ClearDirectedHalf
eventsFunctions.sentence: Restore the full radial shell of _PARAM0_
eventsFunctions.description: Disable directed-half filtering without rebuilding geometry.

eventsFunctions.name: SetUpperHalfVisibility
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set upper half of _PARAM0_ visible to _PARAM1_
eventsFunctions.description: Toggle all upper shell and enabled upper radial material groups without rebuilding geometry.

eventsFunctions.name: SetLowerHalfVisibility
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set lower half of _PARAM0_ visible to _PARAM1_
eventsFunctions.description: Toggle all lower shell and enabled lower radial material groups without rebuilding geometry.

eventsFunctions.name: SetRadialFaceEnabled
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set radial direction _PARAM1_ of _PARAM0_ enabled to _PARAM2_
eventsFunctions.description: Enable one of six center-to-edge radial half-faces.

eventsFunctions.name: SetRadialFaceMask
eventsFunctions.description: Set all six radial directions with a bit mask from 0 to 63.

eventsFunctions.name: SetFaceVisibility
eventsFunctions.description: Show or hide any rhombus, cut, or radial face.

eventsFunctions.name: SetFaceTexture
eventsFunctions.description: Assign a texture to any face.

eventsFunctions.name: SetRepeatTextureOnFace
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set face _PARAM1_ texture repetition of _PARAM0_ to _PARAM2_
eventsFunctions.description: Enable texture tiling on a face.

eventsFunctions.name: SetMasterTexture
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set master wrapping texture of _PARAM0_ to _PARAM1_
eventsFunctions.description: A non-empty texture overrides every per-face texture and uses continuous exterior shell UV wrapping. Clear it to restore stored per-face textures.

eventsFunctions.name: SetTint
eventsFunctions.description: Set the shape tint.

eventsFunctions.name: IsDirectedHalfActive
eventsFunctions.description: Check whether shell sector filtering is active.

eventsFunctions.name: IsUpperHalfVisible
eventsFunctions.description: Check whether any upper shell face is visible.

eventsFunctions.name: IsLowerHalfVisible
eventsFunctions.description: Check whether any lower shell face is visible.

eventsFunctions.name: IsRadialFaceEnabled
eventsFunctions.description: Check a radial direction bit.

eventsFunctions.name: IsFaceVisible
eventsFunctions.description: Check face visibility.

eventsFunctions.name: DirectedHalfDirection
eventsFunctions.description: Return direction 0 to 5, or -1 when the full shell is active.

eventsFunctions.name: RadialFaceMask
eventsFunctions.description: Return the six-bit radial mask.

eventsFunctions.name: MasterTexture
eventsFunctions.description: Return the active master texture resource, or an empty string when per-face textures are active.

eventsFunctions.name: FaceTexture
eventsFunctions.description: Return a face texture resource name.

eventsFunctions.name: DeltaX
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the lateral column offset Delta X = sqrt(3) * Req for seamless gapless honeycomb tiling.

eventsFunctions.name: DeltaZ
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the longitudinal row offset Delta Z = 1.5 * Req for seamless gapless honeycomb tiling.

eventsFunctions.name: HexToWorldX
eventsFunctions.description: Converts hexagonal grid (Col, Row) to world X coordinate with odd-row staggering.

eventsFunctions.name: HexToWorldZ
eventsFunctions.description: Converts hexagonal grid (Col, Row) to world Z coordinate.

eventsFunctions.name: WorldToHexCol
eventsFunctions.fullName: World X, Z to hex grid Col
eventsFunctions.description: Converts 3D world (X, Z) to nearest hexagonal grid column.

eventsFunctions.name: WorldToHexRow
eventsFunctions.fullName: World X, Z to hex grid Row
eventsFunctions.description: Converts 3D world (X, Z) to nearest hexagonal grid row.

eventsFunctions.name: SnapX
eventsFunctions.fullName: Snap world X to honeycomb grid
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the snapped world X coordinate on the hexagonal honeycomb grid.

eventsFunctions.name: SnapZ
eventsFunctions.fullName: Snap world Z to honeycomb grid
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the snapped world Z coordinate on the hexagonal honeycomb grid.
